summary: Add native mission and step escalation policy declarations without delivery behavior

replay.detail: No history rewrite or reconciliation change.

schema.detail: Mission and step escalation declarations use inherit/disable/replace tags. Required scope-unique policy IDs identify delivery episodes; state is a scope-checked runtime literal, clocks are since-progress/since-entered, and KDL accepts and emits human durations. Empty blocks are rejected.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule change.

compatibility.detail: Older parsers reject escalation nodes. Follow-up: a reader capability check enforced at publish, requiring mission-escalation-v1 on every supported reader before accepting these declarations. No existing escalation reader capability gate is claimed in this schema-only slice.

manual.detail: Upgrade all readers before authoring policies until the publish capability check lands. No intermediate migration or backfill is required. Delivery is a separate slice: each overdue stage once, in order, idempotent per (policy, stage, episode), never re-fired after restart.

recovery.detail: Remove escalation declarations and republish before rolling back to a reader without escalation support.
